title: dynamic-qa Result Envelope v1
description: The Result Envelope DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §5.6 left as a placeholder and #151 handed to #153 to define: 'small, non-executable, schema-validated, size-bounded, and tied to repository, source SHA, workflow/run, and artifact digest. A privileged lane may consume only this envelope or recompute the result.' It is a provider/run artifact, not routine Git history — never committed, never referenced by a Flow ID directly. It carries no field capable of holding executable content (no free-form script, command, path, or URL field is defined here at all — see dynamic-qa/shared/scripts/result-envelope.mjs, which is the hand-written fail-closed validator and the actual size-bound enforcement; this document is the human-readable contract only, no JSON Schema validator dependency is added, matching every other schema in this bundle). trust-zones.mjs's checkPrivilegedLaneArtifact (#151) stays the sole gate deciding whether the privileged-publication zone may accept an artifact of kind 'result-envelope' at all; this schema only constrains what such an artifact's envelope payload may contain once that gate has already accepted it.

schema.description: Immutable. Any other value is an unsupported-schema-version error, never a silent upgrade.

repository.description: Exact 'owner/name' the run belongs to, so a privileged lane never trusts an envelope produced for a different repository.

sourceCommit.description: The full commit SHA the run verified — never a branch name or short SHA, mirroring provenance.mjs's and trust-zones.mjs's own sourceCommit format.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the envelope was produced.

provider.description: Only a named, tested provider adapter identity — never generic.

workflowFile.description: The exact workflow file path the run executed, e.g. '.github/workflows/dynamic-qa.yml'.

url.description: Optional provider run URL, for a human to open; never treated as evidence on its own.

verdict.description: The overall run verdict. A privileged lane trusts this only after schema and size validation, and only for a validated 'result-envelope' artifact kind (trust-zones.mjs's checkPrivilegedLaneArtifact).

junitDigest.description: Content digest of the Binding's own JUnit output, so a privileged lane (or a later recompute) can prove which exact JUnit bytes this verdict came from, without re-executing anything.

bindings.description: Bounded to 50 entries — one small line per Binding, never the JUnit body itself. Enforces the small/size-bounded requirement structurally, not only via the byte-count check in result-envelope.mjs.

artifactDigest.description: Content digest of the full run's combined JUnit/report artifact bytes. A privileged lane consumes only this digest (or independently recomputes it) — never the underlying artifact bytes as an executable input.
